reviews.title: Plug and play
reviews.comment:
Bought this at some point last year and after using it as a backup drive for a few months I was given a laptop which had a hdd, so naturally I swapped it out for this one. It has been running great since, haven’t had any loading issues or anything else to complain about
(This is my laptop’s current C: drive, being used alongside a 1tb nvme to dual boot Linux mint)

The other drive in the picture is unrelated it’s just the only picture I had of it before putting it in my laptop

reviews.title: Great drive
reviews.comment: Runs fast, cool and quiet (obviously but what else can you say about a SATA SSD? No issues so far.
